items.heading: 3-Task Limit. No Overload.
items.body: Visual peace. We hide the noise and only show your top 3 tasks. No scrolling through endless lists that trigger "waiting mode" or panic.

items.heading: AI Friction-Mapping. One-Tap Starts.
items.body: Instant activation. One tap "flips" any daunting goal into its smallest physical starting action. Our AI handles the mental labor of planning so you can just move.

items.heading: Calendar-First. Zero Guilt.
items.body: Temporal awareness. We sync your schedule and nominate tasks that actually fit your time gaps. No "overdue" red badges—just a clear window of what's possible right now.
